simple.meaning: קֶשֶׁב (qesheb) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a hearkening.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 4 times in 1 Kings, 2 Kings, Isaiah, beginning at 1 Kings 18:29. The surrounding contexts include offering.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֶשֶׁב (H7182) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: קֶשֶׁב (qesheb) / H7182 is traced through 1 Kings 18:29, 2 Kings 4:31, Isaiah 21:7 with source-language evidence and verse context.
